MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The reusable VELCRO straps fit my recent Ethernet and USB cable purchases and desk organization activity; I could use them immediately and reopen them when changing connections.",
    "The SSD and larger memory card connect to my computer and Raspberry Pi interests, so they are worth considering, although neither represents a confirmed need right now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The TV mount, speaker wire, and CPU cooler require projects I have not shown a need for; buying HDMI cables or headphones does not mean I am mounting a TV, wiring speakers, or building a desktop.",
    "The 14-inch bag does not fit my 15-inch laptop and overlaps with my recent backpack choice, while another 32GB card duplicates storage I already have.",
    "The Echo Dot has no clear role in my current setup, and the 12TB drive assumes a much larger storage need than I have identified."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been stretched into interest in equipment for almost any home technology project.",
    "My memory card interactions seem to have been treated as a continuing need for more storage, without enough attention to duplicate capacity or whether I need an upgrade."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent cable, headphone holder, and cleaning equipment interactions point toward organizing and maintaining an existing computer setup, which makes useful finishing accessories especially relevant.",
    "Fit and compatibility matter: a bag needs to accommodate my laptop, and an internal SSD needs to work with my computer before I would choose it.",
    "I interact frequently with accessories, but that does not mean I need replacements or additional versions of items I already have; an immediate practical use matters more than a general connection to my interests."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my computer accessory interests but missed that my current intent is to organize and maintain my existing setup, with upgrades dependent on a specific need."
}
